warnings: Index records were built as deterministic structured-text encodings only (encoding_model=structured_text_only); no embedding or search backend was configured for this run, so encoded_knowledge_records.jsonl is the delivered index-ready text corpus rather than a live search index.

8 simple, single-fact benchmark questions were manually defined from validated Knowledge Cards and Evidence Units (not invented by script) and run through validation/scripts/run_lexical_retrieval_benchmark.py, a deterministic lexical token-overlap baseline, to exercise the index; this is a baseline retrieval check, not an evaluation of any production embedding/search backend.

source_adequacy_score is left null for all 8 benchmark rows because human review is not requested for this run; recall/precision are computed at the run level from the gold and returned record IDs in validation/run_validation_summary.json.
